verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS database platform that ships a CLI and a hosted MCP server, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics collection, or any way to opt out of either. The Insights items describe server-side analysis of the customer's own database traffic, which is a product feature rather than vendor usage tracking, so they are not credited here.
